Material: HYDROCHLORIC ACID
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 20 gallons
WHILE UNLOADING CONTAINERIZED CARGO FROM THE HORIZON CHALLENGER, THE HATCH COVER WAS REMOVED FROM THE HATCH AND CONTAINER HRZU434310-0 WAS DISCOVERED LEAKING UN1789, HYDROCHLORIC ACID, 8, PGII. THE ACID HAD SPILLED ON THE CONTAINER HRZU430589 WHICH WAS BELOW IT. THER WAS ABOUT 10 GALLONS OF PRODUCT THAT HAD LEAKED ON TOP OF ANOTHER CLASS 8 CONTAINER. THE LEAKING CONTAINER CONTAINED 38 DOUBLE STACKED 275 GALLON "RESIDUE, LAST CONTAINED". THE USCG HAS BEEN NOTIFIED AND ARE WORKING WITH PHMSA ON THE INCIDENT. THE FINAL DETERMINATION ON THE CAUSE OF THE LEAK WILL BE MADE TOMORROW WITH THE USCG AND PHMSA PRESENT AT THE UNLOADING OF THE TOTES.

Material: UNKNOWN OIL (HYDRAULIC OR MOTOR OIL)
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: HOMAX OIL SALES
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 800 gallons
I AM NOT SURE EXACTLY WHICH DAY OF THE FIRST WEEK OF JULY, 2005 THAT THIS INCIDENT OCCURRED, BUT UPON REPORTING FOR WORK ONE MORNING THAT WEEK, I WAS INFORMED THAT A SPILL OF APPROXIMATELY 800 GALLONS OF OIL HAD BEEN RELEASED ONTO THE GROUND FROM ONE OF THE TANKS, INCLUDED IN A "TANK FARM" STILL UNDER CONSTRUCTION. I OBSERVED SAID OIL SPILL. SUBSEQUENT ACTIONS THAT I OBSERVED, THAT WERE TAKEN BY THE BUSINESS OPERATOR WERE THE APPLICATION OF ABSORBANT MATERIAL RESEMBLING CAT LITTER, EVENTUALLY FOLLOWED BY A LAYER OF STONE MATERIAL. THE ONLY REMEDY THE OPERATOR SOUGHT WAS TO COVER THIS SPILL UP. THIS SPILL SEEPED INTO THE GROUND AND CONTAMINATED GROUND IN A RESIDENTIAL AREA OF THE CITY; POSSIBLY A WATER TABLE! LOCATION: TANK FARM LOCATED AT EAST END OF BUSINESS LOT, BETWEEN FORE AND AFT TANKS (TWO ROWS OF TANKS -4 EACH - RUNNING NORTH TO SOUTH) BETWEEN TANKS NORTH QUADRANT.
